items.exampleEn: This old shoe needs to be mended.
It took us a week to unpack after we moved.
items.exampleZh: 搬家後，我們花了一週才把東西整理好。

items.exampleEn: Autumn came, and the leaves began to wither.
items.exampleZh: 秋天到了，葉子開始凋謝。

items.exampleEn: Owing to the traffic, we arrived late.
items.exampleZh: 由於交通擁擠，我們遲到了。

items.exampleEn: Too much wrapping is bad for the earth.
items.exampleZh: 過多的包裝對地球不好。

items.exampleEn: Her hands shook involuntarily in the cold.
items.exampleZh: 她的手在寒冷中不由自主地發抖。

items.exampleEn: This movie retells a famous old story.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影重述了一個有名的老故事。

items.sentenceEn: Please unpack the boxes in the kitchen.
items.sentenceZh: 請把廚房裡的箱子拆開整理。

items.audioEn: The outdoor concert was canceled owing to the strong wind.
items.audioZh: 戶外音樂會由於強風而取消了。

items.sentenceEn: This wrapping paper can be used again.
items.sentenceZh: 這張包裝紙可以再用一次。

items.sentenceEn: He laughed involuntarily at the joke.
items.sentenceZh: 他聽到那個笑話，不由自主地笑了出來。

items.stemEn: Could you ____ the story for those who were absent?
items.stemZh: 你能為缺席的人重述這個故事嗎？

items.stemEn: Tear off the ____ and see what's inside the box!
items.stemZh: 把包裝撕掉，看看盒子裡有什麼！

items.passageEn: Last month, my family flew to visit my grandma for her birthday. As soon as we arrived, we unpacked our bags. My mom gave Grandma a gift in red wrapping. Inside was a sweater, but it had a small hole, so Grandma mended it herself. Grandma's garden looked sad: many flowers had withered owing to the dry weather. That evening, Grandma retold the story of how she met Grandpa. When she finished, I involuntarily said, "How beautiful!" It was a memorable night.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們全家搭飛機去探望奶奶，為她慶生。我們一到，就打開行李整理東西。媽媽送給奶奶一份用紅色包裝紙包著的禮物。裡面是一件毛衣，但有一個小洞，所以奶奶自己把它補好了。奶奶的花園看起來很淒涼：由於天氣乾燥，很多花都枯萎了。那天晚上，奶奶重述了她和爺爺相遇的故事。她說完時，我不由自主地說了一聲「好美啊！」那是一個難忘的夜晚。

options: 顏色和奶奶的衣服一樣

questions.questionZh: 花園裡的花為什麼枯萎了？
options: 因為奶奶出門旅行太久沒澆水
因為被鄰居家的狗踩壞了

items.promptZh: 爸爸幫我修好了腳踏車輪胎。
referenceEn: My dad mended my bike tire for me.
My father mended my bike tire.
rubricZh: mend 表示「修補、修理」，例如 mend a tire 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 retell 造一個句子，說說你會重述哪個故事給誰聽。
referenceEn: I like to retell funny stories to my little brother.
I retold the story of my favorite movie to my friends.
rubricZh: retell 表示「重述」，例如 retell a story 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或習慣（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式或過去式等）
